name: Velten (Germany)
description: Hanging banner with vertical stripes of green, white and green, charged above the centre with the city arms of Velten (a green wall on white).
history: Municipal flag of Velten; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Velten arms — green wall on white
